overview: You left the account book shut. The three leaves were not opened into the page. You did not write a new sum. The sixpence for firing and washing is the standing charge from Michaelmas, and it was not entered again this morning.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Looked at the shut book, and wrote nothing.

assets.name: the account book
assets.disposition: Did not open the account book

summary: Did not open the account book
